correctness.rationale: Every palindrome is disjointly assigned by its number (0–3) of marked ones. The exact four-case counts and the b=c/b!=c min/max identities give the defect formula for every nonnegative gap quadruple. A bijective layer decomposition produces the rational generating series, and a triple-pole asymptotic plus Riemann sums gives the limiting distribution. A fully independent literal-palindrome checker passed 52,360 words, all layer counts for lengths 3–34, 18^4 gap combinations and exact rational moments; these finite tests supplement, not replace, the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Weight three is the first binary sparse layer with non-rich words; the derived formula completely describes this natural threshold. It yields the entire infinite minimal forbidden-family list, exact counts by every positive defect and word length, and a nontrivial limiting probability distribution with an atom and explicit moments. This is an all-length structural classification rather than a small-n census, notation substitution or re-evaluation of a known table.
